headline: New internal ALB will incur modest recurring costs (~$16-17/month plus traffic-based LCU charges) not mentioned in the PR description

findings.evidence_ref: New aws_lb resource with load_balancer_type = "application" introduced in the diff; PR description does not mention cost implications
findings.explanation: Adding an Application Load Balancer incurs hourly charges plus data processing costs. While modest, the cost should be called out when introducing new infrastructure to track whether this change was intentional and approved at the right level.
